articles.summary: Collaboration aims to advance ARespo's innovative therapies through the commercialized enFuse® drug delivery technology CINCINNATI and BOSTON, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Enable Injections, Inc. ("Enable"), a healthcare innovation company developing and manufacturing the enFuse® On-Body Delivery System, and ARespo Biopharma, Inc. (“ARespo”), an emerging developer of next generation Alpha-1 Antitrypsin therapies, today announced a new partnership to utilize the enFuse technology with specific ARespo development programs. ARespo is advancing programs focused on addressing persistent treatment gaps for individuals living with Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD), initially with an emphasis on best-in-class AATD replacement therapies, aimed at improving both clinical outcomes and the patient experience. “At ARespo, we are committed to advancing innovative treatments for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency, where significant unmet patient needs remain,” said Jay Mohr, CEO and Co-founder
